title: Migration fails loudly when a legacy role has no mapping target
preconds: Test tenant with a user assigned to a legacy role that has been removed from the canonical map (simulate via DB injection of an orphan legacy role value).
steps:
1. Run the migration.
2. Inspect exit code.
3. Inspect stderr.
4. Inspect the orphan user's role_v2_id post-migration.
expected: Migration exits non-zero. Stderr identifies the orphan legacy role and the affected user(s). role_v2_id remains NULL (NOT silently set). Operator must fix the mapping before retry.
